market_question: Will the UK designate the IRGC a terrorist organization by June 30?
reasoning: The UK has already proscribed IRGC sub-entities like the Basij (2022) and repeatedly stated it is keeping full designation under review. Heightened tensions with Iran over nuclear ambitions, support for Russia, and Houthi attacks make a formal designation plausible within the next year, though diplomatic caution persists. I estimate a 15% probability, well above the market's 6%.
evidence_points: UK proscribed the Basij paramilitary force (an IRGC unit) as a terrorist group in October 2022.
Multiple UK government statements from 2023–2024 indicated that designation of the full IRGC was under active review.
Iran's ongoing support for Russia in Ukraine and Houthi attacks in the Red Sea increase pressure on the UK to act unilaterally.
The Labour government (since July 2024) has not ruled out designation, but its historical diplomatic tone tempers the probability.
sources_consulted: Home Office press release on Basij proscription (2022)
Reuters/BBC reports on UK considering IRGC designation (2023–2024)
